shortDescription: Online bill payment firm Doxo will pay $2.1 million to settle Federal Trade Commission allegations that the company and two of its co-founders used misleading search ads to impersonate consumers' billers and misled consumers about millions of dollars in fees they tacked on to consumers' bills.View…

children: Online bill payment firm Doxo will pay $2.1 million to settle Federal Trade Commission allegations that the company and two of its co-founders used misleading search ads to impersonate consumers' billers and misled consumers about millions of dollars in fees they tacked on to consumers' bills.

title: FTC Release: Bill Payment Firm Doxo to Pay $2.1 Million to Settle FTC Allegations It Deceived Consumers and Charged Them Add-On Fees
